payload.purpose_tldr: Boundary fixture: forbidden legacy aggregate prefix feature/.
payload.purpose_context: Identical to the envelope_valid_canonical MissionCreated baseline except that aggregate_id uses the legacy 'feature' prefix. The prefix check shipped with the cutover artifact and was removed with it in 8.0.0, so validate_event accepts this envelope and no profile replaces the check (tracked upstream as the aggregate-prefix decision). Offline rewrite jobs should still convert such ids.
